हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
In that village, a Brahmarakshasa is known for abducting brides on their wedding night.
Despite being aware of this terrifying truth, Indu arrives there to ensure her friend's wedding takes place.
Will she be able to stop the Brahmarakshasa?
Watch “Brahmarakshasa”, streaming exclusively on Kuku TV.
